notes: Unnormalized forward radix-2 DIT FFT with bit-reversed loading and natural output order. Four shared 27x24 signed multipliers execute 192 butterflies. Acceptance takes one edge, each of six stages takes 65 edges, and output registration takes one edge. The 400-edge initiation interval is supported. Reset cancels processing without clearing sample storage. Samples retain four fractional bits; twiddles have 22 fractional bits, with exact unity and quarter-turn coefficients. Rounding is nearest, ties toward positive infinity. Full-domain complex magnitude remains below 2.967 million, within the internal ±4.194304-million range. The first two stages are exact; bounding coefficient and rounding errors through the remaining four stages gives less than 2.2 output units per component, including final integer rounding, satisfying both field error limits. No tools were used; mapped resources and 200 MHz timing have not been verified.
